name: Coarse Joking
overview: Scripture teaches that believers are called to guard their speech carefully, recognizing that careless or coarse joking can lead to trouble and accountability before God. Proverbs warns against using deceptive or frivolous words under the guise of humor, while Matthew reminds us that every idle word will be judged. Ephesians exhorts Christians to walk worthy of their calling by avoiding corrupt communication and instead speaking words that build up and minister grace, reflecting their identity as followers of God.
